Validation sequence ambiguity — 4-step validation (lint→test→build→run) listed but no explicit failure-handling instructions; agents may skip steps on first success

Error recovery decision tree — no guidance on what to do when lint/test/build fails (fix-then-retry vs escalate vs skip); agents may loop or abandon

'Maintain or improve test coverage' is ambiguous — no threshold defined; agents don't know if adding 1 test satisfies the rule or if coverage % must increase
